reels.caption:
I think we just found the coolest villa in the Caribbean… 🏝️🚤

Perched on the rugged cliffs of Moskito Island in the British Virgin Islands, Cape Stout is a luxury villa built for explorers. Wake up to the sound of the ocean crashing below, dive straight into your infinity pool, then set off by boat to discover hidden coves, uninhabited beaches, and some of the clearest water in the Caribbean islands 🌊

Spend the afternoon paddleboarding along the coast or snorkelling with turtles, and return in time for pool party.

💡 BD Tip: Come ready to explore. Moskito Island is private, but the adventures around it are endless.

Who's adding Cape Stout to their bucket list? 🌊
